product.name: Omnistrate Control Plane as a Service
product.description: A cloud-native platform that enables rapid building, deployment, and scaling of multi-tenant SaaS products across multiple clouds and on-premises environments.

product.name: SaaS Operations Automation
product.description: Automation tools for managing SaaS infrastructure, deployments, scaling, monitoring, and security across multi-cloud and on-premises environments.

product.name: SaaS Billing and Subscription Management
product.description: Tenant-aware, usage-based billing and subscription management system integrated with cloud marketplaces and payment processing.

product.name: Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Deployment Support
product.description: Support for deploying SaaS applications across any cloud provider, on-premises, air-gapped, and sovereign cloud environments with flexible tenancy models.

product.name: Developer Tooling and APIs
product.description: Tools and APIs for onboarding applications, configuring services, and managing SaaS products with integration to CI/CD and GitOps workflows.
